What kind of person was your father?{wait}{clear}

But in the dispute over the new emperor, he lost a duel to Alberic... and died.{wait}{clear}
...That day, my father objected to the reasons the great noble Kreutzfeld gave for backing his candidate for emperor...{wait}{clear}
Kreutzfeld claimed that Endymion, with the same red eyes and silver hair as the founding emperor, was the one fit to rule.{wait}{clear}
My father criticized that openly. Choosing a king by the color of his eyes and hair was absurd, he said...{wait}{clear}
Angered by that, Alberic, the Kreutzfeld son and a knight, challenged my father to a duel...{wait}{clear}
I was there too, and I thought my father was right...{wait}{clear}
I knew Alberic was a man of no great skill with a sword...{wait}{clear}
I thought my father would brush him aside easily and end the duel...{wait}{clear}
But... my father... fell to that man's sword...{wait}{clear}
I couldn't believe it... Why... how could my father lose to a man like that...?{wait}{clear}
The Empire's finest knight objecting to the succession and losing a duel worked in the Kreutzfelds' favor.{wait}{clear}
In the end, young Endymion took the throne, and Kreutzfeld became chancellor...{wait}{clear}
And Alberic took my father's post... captain of the First Knights, the Empire's foremost knight.{wait}{clear}
Now the Empire... is controlled by that father and son... and the world has become like this...{wait}{clear}
I will defeat that father and son, my father's killers...{wait}{clear}
I will protect the Empire's honor and clear my father's name...{wait}{clear}
I swear it on this gauntlet...{wait}{clear}
